name: Consensus
desc: Searches 220M+ peer-reviewed papers and answers with citations.
desc_zh: 检索两亿多篇同行评审论文，回答附带引用。
solves: Answers research questions from the literature instead of the open web, so you get findings rather than blog posts.
solves_zh: 答案来自学术文献而非开放网页，给的是研究结论而不是博客观点。
best_for: Reaching for it when you need what the evidence actually says about a question.
best_for_zh: 想知道某个问题上的证据到底怎么说时。
notes: 外部发现渠道补录：2026 research-tool roundups; Consensus $30M Series B coverage (2.5M monthly researchers)。来源：https://docs.consensus.app
